title: GitHub account opens
body: github.com/ryaneditraj was created. The same day holds Number Guessing Game, Letter Game, and the start of The CLI Restaurant.
source: GitHub users API created_at, and repository created_at values, fetched 2026-10-23.

title: Early Flask exercises
body: Word Counter is in the public account, described as a three-hour Flask app. Restaurant Flask sits nearby, dated June 2022, with only a one-line description.
source: Repository descriptions and the Word Counter README.

title: An earlier site is archived
body: Old-Portfolio is created to hold a former ryaneditraj.github.io. Its page called Ryan a self-taught web and app developer. That is a 2023 self-description, not the 2026 profile README.

title: Hack Club projects
body: Space 3D site, the Waffles page, and later in the same month the Keeb keyboard files. The Space repo description says it had been a while since he last programmed, and Hack Club made it happen.
source: Repository descriptions for Space-3d-site, waffles-site, and Keeb-Keyboard.

title: Indiquant is published
body: The quant research OS for NSE and BSE goes up. The README calls it a Money Radar product by Thugir Group, maintained by Ryan Editraj. His author page on moneyradar.in calls him founder of MoneyRadar and Thugir Group.

title: Public profiles checked
body: X, LinkedIn, GitHub, thugirlabs.com, thugir.com, and moneyradar.in were read on this day. He states that he is 16. The pages here place him in India and leave out any finer address. The GitHub bio calls him a Linux fan. A school name that appears on some profiles is omitted at his request.
source: X API, LinkedIn profile, GitHub users API, thugirlabs.com, and moneyradar.in/about/ryan-editraj, checked 23 October 2026.

title: X account opens
body: https://x.com/ryaneditraj is created. The bio checked in October 2026 calls him founder and CEO of Thugir Labs and states that he is 16.

title: Thugir Labs, as dated on LinkedIn
body: LinkedIn lists him as founder of Thugir Labs from March 2026. The day above is the month, not a filing date. No company registration was found. Thugir Group is the parent he names for MoneyRadar and Thugir Labs.
source: LinkedIn profile https://linkedin.com/in/ryaneditraj, checked 23 October 2026. Parent company: moneyradar.in/about/ryan-editraj.

title: He posts a Thugir Labs launch note
body: He posted a launch note for Thugir Labs. Figures in that post are not repeated here.

title: Thugir Labs publishes research notes
body: Research notes go up on thugirlabs.com. This site does not reprint them.

title: He posts about Liya Tech
body: The Liya Tech inaugural hackathon was held on 11 July 2026. The organizer and other participants wrote about the event. He posted two days later. This site records that he took part. It does not record a place.
